## Overview

The [European Commission](../institutions/european-commission.qmd) issues these reports for euro-area member states that received financial assistance, until most of the loans are repaid. They assess the countries' capacity to repay the loans of the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd) and its predecessor institutions. The document type covers economic, fiscal, and financial developments and is published every spring and autumn. This card currently draws on one source document.

## Use in the Rating Process

This document type feeds off-market financing ([Refinancing Need#R1-A*]), backstop eligibility ([Backstop Eligibility](../parameters/backstop-eligibility.qmd)), and outlook material (Outlook Factors#R7*). It provides data on outstanding debt to official creditors and assessments of debt sustainability and financial stability risks.

## Methods

- Projections are based on the Commission’s Spring 2026 Economic Forecast. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2">ⓘ</button>
- Fiscal assessments use the Commission’s Spring 2026 Economic Forecast and the Debt Sustainability Monitor 2025. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2, 5, 10, 15, 18" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 2, 5, 10, 15, 18">ⓘ</button>
- Debt sustainability and refinancing risks are assessed using data from the Debt Sustainability Monitor 2025 and national debt management offices. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 5, 10, 14, 18" aria-label="Source: ec/post-programme/Post-Programme-Surveillance-Spring-2026_2026-06-03, p. 5, 10, 14, 18">ⓘ</button>
